items.question: What must be concealed with effort among the lowest men in the mortal world?
premises: the teaching is to be hidden
items.inference: The verse commands that the secret teaching be carefully concealed from unworthy people in the mortal realm.
uncertainties: whether narādhame is locative or vocative
items.plain_english: It must be concealed with effort in the mortal world among the lowest of men.

rows.grounds: compound meaning tested for one year

items.question: To whom and after what testing should the teaching be given?
premises: the teaching is to be given
items.inference: The verse restricts transmission to one who is already accomplished and has been tested for a year.
uncertainties: whether dātavyaṃ is nominative or accusative
items.plain_english: It is to be given to one previously accomplished, tested for one year.

items.question: Which chapter is said to have emerged from candradīpa?
items.inference: The verse identifies the fifth chapter as having emerged from candradīpa.
uncertainties: whether candradvīpa+vinirgate is locative absolute or adjective
items.plain_english: The fifth chapter emerged from candradīpa.

items.question: By whose grace does the speaker claim to have known the determination of kaula?
premises: the speaker has known kaula determination
items.inference: The verse attributes knowledge of kaula determination to the grace of the lord of kaulas.
uncertainties: whether jñāto agrees with ahaṃ or kaula+nirṇayaḥ
items.plain_english: By your grace, O lord of kaulas, I have known the determination of kaula.

items.question: Who is the declared soul, and what is the nature of the soul?
items.inference: The verse asks both for the identity of the declared soul and for the nature of soul itself.
uncertainties: whether samuddiṣṭaḥ modifies jīvaḥ or asau
whether kiṃ vā is disjunctive or rhetorical
items.plain_english: Who is that declared soul, or what is the nature of the soul?

items.question: In what does dissolution go, and what all should be told to the speaker?
premises: the speaker asks for all of it
items.inference: The verse asks where dissolution goes and requests a complete account of that matter.
uncertainties: whether kasmiṃś is masculine or neuter
whether tat+sarvaṃ refers to dissolution or the whole teaching
items.plain_english: In what indeed does dissolution go? Tell me all that.
